dialogue.speaker: doctor
dialogue.text: How long has your back been hurting?

dialogue.speaker: patient
dialogue.text: About one week, mostly in my lower back.

dialogue.speaker: parent
dialogue.text: It started after he lifted that heavy box in the garage.

dialogue.speaker: patient
dialogue.text: Yes, it started later that evening.

dialogue.speaker: doctor
dialogue.text: Does the pain stay in your back?

dialogue.speaker: patient
dialogue.text: No. Sometimes it travels down my left leg.

dialogue.speaker: parent
dialogue.text: He complained about the leg pain yesterday too.

dialogue.speaker: doctor
dialogue.text: Any numbness or loss of sensation?

dialogue.speaker: doctor
dialogue.text: Any difficulty controlling your bladder or bowels?

dialogue.speaker: parent
dialogue.text: He can still walk, but he moves much more carefully now.

dialogue.speaker: doctor
dialogue.text: I will examine your back, strength, reflexes, and sensation in both legs.
